title: Effect of Catheter Ablation vs Antiarrhythmic Drug Therapy on Mortality, Stroke, Bleeding, and Cardiac Arrest Among Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: The CABANA Randomized Clinical Trial
setting: multicentre AF ablation versus antiarrhythmic-drug trial
outcomes_summary: Primary endpoint 8.0% vs 9.2% (HR 0.86); cardiovascular hospitalization/death favored ablation (HR 0.83); AF recurrence reduced (HR 0.52).

title: Association between comorbidity burden and outcomes of catheter ablation vs. medical therapy for atrial fibrillation: insights from the CABANA trial
study_type: post hoc heterogeneity analysis of randomized trial
setting: CABANA subgroup analysis by comorbidity burden
outcomes_summary: Benefit of ablation concentrated in higher-comorbidity patients, HR 0.62 vs 1.16 in low-burden group (interaction P=0.038).

title: Association of atrial tissue fibrosis identified by delayed enhancement MRI and atrial fibrillation catheter ablation: the DECAAF study
setting: delayed-enhancement MRI phenotyping before AF ablation
outcomes_summary: Atrial fibrosis strongly stratified recurrence, 15.3% in stage 1 vs 69.4% in stage 4; HR 1.06 per 1% fibrosis.

title: Screening for Dilated Cardiomyopathy in At-Risk First-Degree Relatives
setting: screening first-degree relatives of dilated cardiomyopathy probands
outcomes_summary: New DCM-related findings in 14.1% of relatives, including 2.1% overt DCM.

title: Family Screening in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Identification of Relatives With Low Yield From Systematic Follow-Up
setting: longitudinal HCM relative screening with clinical and genetic follow-up
outcomes_summary: Baseline yield 26%; only 43 incident HCM diagnoses over 6762 person-years, with very-low-risk subgroup conversion 0.4%.

title: Accuracy of Machine Learning Models for Early Prediction of Major Cardiovascular Events Post Myocardial Infarction: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
setting: post-MI machine-learning prognostic studies
outcomes_summary: Across 28 studies, pooled C-index 0.77 with sensitivity 0.78 and specificity 0.85 for major cardiovascular events.

title: Screening for cardiac contractile dysfunction using an artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiogram
study_type: retrospective derivation and external test study
setting: paired routine 12-lead ECG and echocardiography datasets
outcomes_summary: AUC 0.93 for LVEF <=40%; positive AI-ECG associated with later ventricular dysfunction (HR 4.1).

title: An artificial intelligence-enabled ECG algorithm for the identification of patients with atrial fibrillation during sinus rhythm: a retrospective analysis of outcome prediction
setting: sinus-rhythm ECG repository linked to AF labels
outcomes_summary: Single ECG AUC 0.87 for latent AF, improving to 0.90 with serial ECGs.

title: Detection of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Using a Convolutional Neural Network-Enabled Electrocardiogram
setting: development and held-out test cohorts for HCM detection from ECG
outcomes_summary: Test AUC 0.96 with sensitivity 87% and specificity 90%; especially strong in younger patients.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Electrocardiogram for the Early Detection of Cardiac Amyloidosis
setting: routine ECGs for cardiac amyloidosis case finding
outcomes_summary: Holdout AUC 0.91; 84% of amyloidosis cases detected; 59% signaled >6 months before diagnosis in those with prediagnosis ECGs.

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiogram screens low left ventricular ejection fraction with a degree of confidence
study_type: multicentre retrospective validation with uncertainty estimation
setting: internal and external hospital cohorts with AI confidence scoring
outcomes_summary: Confidence-aware deployment improved external AUC from 0.9365 to 0.9653 after excluding low-confidence cases; future LV dysfunction HR 8.67 for high-confidence positives.

title: External assessment of an artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiogram for aortic stenosis detection
setting: external validation cohort for AI-ECG aortic stenosis detection
outcomes_summary: AUC 0.85 with sensitivity 0.83 and NPV 0.94, supporting rule-out use.

title: Patient Perspectives Towards Artificial Intelligence in Heart Failure Care
setting: heart-failure outpatient perspectives on AI use
outcomes_summary: Only 18.2% were comfortable with AI acting without physician input; 97.3% trusted cardiologists over AI in disagreement.

title: Patients', clinicians' and developers' perspectives and experiences of artificial intelligence in cardiac healthcare: A qualitative study
setting: two English hospitals using cardiac AI tools
outcomes_summary: Patients, clinicians, and developers viewed AI as adjunctive; workflow fit, verification, and data security dominated acceptance.

title: Large Language Model-Based Chatbot vs Surgeon-Generated Informed Consent Documentation for Common Procedures
setting: common-procedure informed consent documentation generation
outcomes_summary: LLM-generated risk-benefit-alternative documents were more complete and readable than routine surgeon-generated text.

title: Large Language Models in Cardiology: Systematic Review
setting: cardiology LLM literature across education, ECG interpretation, and emergency guidance
outcomes_summary: Review found promise in education and ECG interpretation, but inconsistent emergency guidance and heavy reliance on in silico studies.

title: External Validation of Artificial Intelligence-enabled Electrocardiography (AI-ECG) for the Detection of Left Ventricular Dysfunction (NCT07038018)
setting: multicentre hospitals with ECG-echo pairs within 7 days
outcomes_summary: Primary outcome is sensitivity and specificity for LVEF <=40%; designed as explicit external validation across centres.

title: Atrial Fibrillation Risk Estimation With Single-lead Handheld Electrocardiograms (NCT07468123)
setting: pilot handheld single-lead ECG screening in patients stratified by prior AI-ECG risk
outcomes_summary: Compares new AF diagnosis over 1 year in high- versus low-risk groups and assesses acceptability of AI-informed screening.

title: Computational Cardiac Imaging Analysis to Guide Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation Procedures (NCT06964152)
setting: use of computational ECG and cardiac imaging tools to guide VT ablation
outcomes_summary: Primary outcomes are recurrent VT and all-cause death at 1 year, testing whether AI-derived maps improve procedural guidance.

title: International Study of Artificial Intelligence-based Diagnosis of Cardiomyopathy Using Cardiac MRI (NCT05793840)
setting: 11-site cardiac MRI study for cardiomyopathy diagnosis and event prediction
outcomes_summary: Evaluates machine-learning 3D heart-structure and deformation models for diagnosis and complication prediction.

title: AI-powered ECG Analysis Using Willem Software in High-risk Cardiac Patients (NCT05890716)
setting: cloud AI ECG platform in high-risk cardiac patients
outcomes_summary: Assesses real-time arrhythmia and abnormal-pattern detection, with claimed goal of reducing harmful or unnecessary interventions.

title: Deep Learning-enhanced Personalized Monitoring of Aortic Stenosis, DETECT-AS Prognostic Study (NCT06749132)
setting: older adults with aortic sclerosis or mild aortic stenosis at three US systems
outcomes_summary: Tests digital biomarker score for precision risk stratification using annualized AV Vmax change.

title: Targeted Assessment in High-Risk paTients With dIAbetes to ideNtify Undiagnosed Heart Failure, TARTAN-HF (NCT05705869)
setting: screening high-risk diabetes patients for undiagnosed heart failure
outcomes_summary: Primary outcome is heart-failure diagnosis within 6 months under targeted screening strategy, an important exemplar of AI-enabled case finding embedded in care pathways.

title: Manual Versus AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Screening Using Large-Language Models (NCT06588452)
setting: heart-failure trial recruitment workflow using EHR screening and LLM assistance
outcomes_summary: Compares manual review versus AI-assisted review for study eligibility determination and enrollment efficiency.

title: Video-Based AI-Generated Peri-operative Instructions for Mitral Valve Surgery (NCT07036926)
setting: patients scheduled for isolated mitral valve repair surgery
outcomes_summary: Tests whether AI-generated interactive peri-operative video education reduces unplanned healthcare utilization and improves patient experience.

title: CABG-AI-Supported Discharge Education (NCT07503678)
setting: post-CABG discharge education via AI-generated nurse-avatar videos
outcomes_summary: Will measure pain, anxiety, cortisol, recovery, and discharge-education satisfaction versus standard education.

title: Machine Learning in Atrial Fibrillation (NCT05371405)
setting: AF cohort using machine learning to delineate AF subtypes and predict ablation outcome
outcomes_summary: Primary endpoint is machine-learning prediction of ablation outcome at 1 year.

title: A Randomised Controlled Trial for the Identification of Undiagnosed Atrial Fibrillation Patients Using a Machine Learning Risk Prediction Algorithm and Diagnostic Test (NCT04045639)
setting: primary-care style AF identification using ML risk prediction plus diagnostic testing
outcomes_summary: Assessed whether ML-driven selection increased AF detection over routine care during a 6-month research window.
